WELCOME TO CAT-SCHOOL! 📚

🔎 Uncover the secrets of the school 🔍 

Enjoying the game? Give us a like👍! 

Be FIRST 🏆 to hear about new updates by pressing 🔔 Follow. 
On phone or tablet? Tap •••, then tap [🔔FOLLOW]
